classification.resume: This is a video recording of a parliamentary question session in the Swiss National Council on 26 September 2016. National Councillor Jean-Luc Addor asked Federal Councillor Simonetta Sommaruga about the revision of the EU firearms directive and requested that Switzerland not adopt stricter gun legislation. The session was part of the 2016 autumn session of the National Council.
